title: RNA Stable Isotope Probing Experimental Set Up
author: Julie Huber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iuzcex6

steps.title: Add DIC to Pyrex Bottles
steps.instruction: Add 8.83 mL of either 12C or 13C DIC (600 mM sterile solution in serum vials) to an evacuated, acid-washed, and sterile, stoppered 500 mL pyrex bottle using a 10 mL syringe with a filter.

substeps.instruction: Ensure final concentration is 10mM (adjust based on experimental design).

steps.title: Fill Bottles with Medium
steps.instruction: Fill each bottle to the 530mL premark using a peristaltic pump at a rate of ~60-100 mL/minute.

substeps.instruction: Change the needle and tubing between isotopes.
If gas build-up prevents filling, release pressure with a needle.

steps.title: Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Add 1 to 1.5mL of 10% HCl to each bottle using a 1 mL syringe.

substeps.instruction: Check pH repeatedly until the desired pH is reached (e.g., pH < 6.5).

steps.title: Add Hydrogen Gas
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of 100% hydrogen gas to each bottle using a 60mL syringe with a stopcock and a small hydrogen bottle.

steps.title: Incubate Bottles
steps.instruction: Incubate bottles on their sides for the appropriate period at the chosen temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Example conditions: 30 °C for 36 hrs, 55 °C for 18-24 hrs, or 80 °C for 9-18 hrs.

steps.title: Filter Fluid
steps.instruction: Filter the fluid through a 0.22 uM Sterivex at ~60 mL/min using a peristaltic pump.

substeps.instruction: Place a needle attached to peristaltic pump tubing and a vent needle in the stopper.
Turn the bottle upside down in a ring stand.
Use 12C tubing for controls and 13C tubing for experiments; maintain strict isotope separation.

steps.title: Preserve and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Once all fluid is filtered, fill the Sterivex with filter-sterilized RNAlater.

steps.title: Clean Peristaltic Pump Tubing
steps.instruction: Clean tubing between experiments using a peristaltic pump and a beaker to pass the following solutions in sequence: DI/MilliQ, 10% HCL, MilliQ, 70% EtOH, and finally MilliQ.

substeps.instruction: Empty and dry the tubing after cleaning.
